newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Oxnard School District, Calif..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Oxnard School District, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, pursuant to section 53692 of the California Government Code, that the Board of Supervisors of Ventura County, California (the Board''), in the name of the Oxnard School District, intends to sell, at public sale, $4,750,000 Oxnard School District (Ventura County, California) 1997 Tax and Revenue Anticipation Notes. Bids will be received at 9:30 A.M., Pacific time, on

and, without further advertising, so long as a proposal has not theretofore been accepted by the Board, on any Thursday thereafter, at the offices of Dale Scott &Company, Inc., 400 Montgomery Street, Suite 805, San Francisco, CA94104, and the sale will be awarded by the Board within 26 hours after the expiration of the time prescribed for the receipt of bids. Further information, including copies of the
Preliminary Official Statement, Official Notice of Sale and Bid Form, may be obtained from Dale Scott & Company, Inc. at the above address.
